name: Omamusic
author: Haripako
description: YouTube Music MPRIS controller with a neon equalizer in the bar, album art, seekable progress bar, shuffle/repeat, and volume in a popup panel

barWidget.description: YouTube Music controller with album art, progress bar, and playback controls

schema.label: Player source
schema.description: Where playback is controlled. Auto prefers a native client and falls back to the browser. Native app gives volume, shuffle and repeat; Browser needs no install and uses its PipeWire stream for volume.

schema.label: Strict browser match
schema.description: Only adopt a browser session while a window titled "YouTube Music" is open. More precise, but goes idle if that window switches to another tab (Hyprland only)

schema.label: Extra player names
schema.description: Comma-separated MPRIS identities or desktop entries to treat as YouTube Music

schema.label: Show volume slider
schema.description: Display a volume slider when the player supports it

schema.label: Scroll to change volume
schema.description: Adjust volume by scrolling over the bar icon

schema.label: Show spectrum visualizer
schema.description: Draw a live audio histogram while playing (requires cava; reflects system audio)

schema.label: Quick links
schema.description: Playlist shortcuts shown in the popup, as "Name|URL" separated by commas. MPRIS cannot switch playlists, so these open the playlist in your browser instead.

schema.label: Quick link behaviour
schema.description: Focus if open raises an existing YouTube Music window instead of stacking duplicate tabs; Always open navigates to the link every time (Hyprland only).

schema.label: Launch command
schema.description: Command run by the play button when nothing is playing. Empty uses the native client if installed, otherwise music.youtube.com

schema.label: Bar neon equalizer
schema.description: Show a neon equalizer in the bar while music is playing

schema.label: Neon color
schema.description: Hex color of the neon equalizer glow

schema.label: Neon bar count
schema.description: Number of bars in the neon equalizer

schema.label: Without cava
schema.description: What the equalizer shows when cava is not installed: a decorative idle animation, or nothing
